hero:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: hero render for an Apple-inspired satirical Portuguese hardware product launch page.
Primary request: create an exquisitely photorealistic studio product photograph of a NEW tiny two-key developer keyboard called Magic Keyboard Pro. The attached image is inspiration for the two-key concept only; redesign it as premium ultra-thin Apple-like hardware.
Subject: a small wide rounded rectangular CNC-machined satin silver aluminum chassis, softly rounded corners, precisely TWO large square pale white low-profile keycaps side by side, finely engraved dark grey microphone icon centered on the LEFT key and the exact Portuguese word "Sim" centered on the RIGHT key. No other buttons. Low-profile sculpted PBT keycaps with subtle concave surfaces and dark narrow gaps, bead-blasted aluminum perimeter, precision bevels. The device is about 18cm wide by 10cm deep and 1.2cm tall. Physically plausible, beautiful understated design.
Scene/backdrop: seamless PURE WHITE #ffffff studio cyclorama, invisible tabletop with a soft natural contact shadow.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 3:2 image. Entire product fully visible in a front three-quarter view from slightly above; device centered horizontally occupying about 75 percent of width. Modest blank white margins. The microphone and "Sim" must be easy to read. Focus sharp over the entire product.
Lighting/mood: immaculate high-end Apple product photography, huge diffused softbox, soft highlights on silver, subtle ambient occlusion, crisp geometry, absolutely luxurious.
Text (verbatim): "Sim" only. Small, centered, restrained modern system sans serif, like SF Pro. Microphone icon clean and geometrically exact.
Constraints: exactly two keys, white keycaps, silver body. No Apple logo, no other branding, no extra text or surrounding UI, no laptop, no hands, no props, no watermark. New original product, not a copy of the black reference.
